patterns: APPSC asks very basic items: 'NOT an objective of sustainable development' (individual wealth accumulation), odd pillar out (political sustainability).
Attribution traps: Limits to Growth = Club of Rome, not Brundtland; Brundtland popularised/first defined it (1987), term in use from 1980.
Agenda 2030 facts: 17 goals, 169 targets, focus on discrimination/violence against women and girls (APPSC).
Concept link: sustainable development intertwined with carrying capacity (UPSC 2010).
App adds index/rank current affairs (SDR, SDG India Index, VNR) and an AP UN-Habitat angle beyond PYQ depth.
